detail.longDescription: # til i learned about The `<geolocation>` HTML element that creates an interactive control for the user to share their location data with the page. It provides: - An intuitive browser-defined UI. - A process for handling the necessary permissions for the geolocation feature. - API features for accessing location data and responding to received location data and permission changes. https:// developer.mozilla.org/en-US/do cs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/geolocation # webdev # frontend # html # mdn
